interpretation.noSubscription: Existing taxonomy defines no mandatory recurring software payment for stated meaningful workflow; free access can qualify. Legal plan word Subscription alone is neither acceptance nor rejection.
interpretation.pricingEvidence: Current documentary findings support review proposals, not verified graph claims.
interpretation.calm: Anchor itself has free content; user need is an alternative guided-meditation workflow, not a claim Calm always requires payment.
interpretation.medical: Clinical marketing statistics, testimonials and benefit claims excluded from dossier and qualification.
interpretation.directory: Stripe Directory skill checked first; CLI/tool unavailable, proceeded with primary sources. No provisioning/donation/contact.

steps: Choose one common supported mobile platform and record OS, app version, storefront region, language and account state for all three plus Calm.
Access only public/free individual content; skip trials, employer/research editions and donation prompts.
Record an adult guided session title/path/duration and whether playback starts without required payment; pause/resume on the same session. Do not assess subjective health improvement.
Record any paywall, account gate, unavailable store or playback error as a restriction, not a product-wide rejection.
Optional downloads are separate from core gate; only test if claiming offline behavior.
Review exact relationship descriptions, pricing and trade-offs before any draft-graph claim proposal; import/publication need later evidence and validation.
